verdict.rationale: React's official docs route new projects to third-party frameworks and starters rather than a first-party React CLI. They recommend Next.js or React Router for full apps, build tools like Vite, Parcel or Rsbuild for from-scratch setups, and Expo for native, and they offer an in-browser sandbox for trying React with no install. The getting-started path is documented, but scaffolding depends on non-React tools. Missing for 10: a first-party React CLI or official starter template, evidence of the actual scaffold-and-run commands and time-to-running, and hands-on corroboration that setup takes only minutes.
